name: appindicator-quicksetting
description: A small GNOME Shell extension that shows running AppIndicator / StatusNotifier apps inside Quick Settings. Inspired by Background Apps.
author: Vasanth M

scripts.build: npm run schemas && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/src && cp extension.js prefs.js metadata.json stylesheet.css LICENSE CREDITS dist/ && cp -r schemas dist/ && cp src/dbusMenu.js dist/src/ && cp -r src/controllers src/protocol src/ui src/utils dist/src/ && gnome-extensions pack --force --out-dir=dist --extra-source=src --extra-source=LICENSE --extra-source=CREDITS dist
